description: Canonical vocabulary for the events in song_event_timeline.json, produced by the phase-3 gestures stage (src/analyzer/stages/gestures.py, plan v3.0 item 9). Replaces the Epic-5 event_* vocabulary, which was measured at chance (CLAUDE.md) and deleted in the same change. Nothing in src/ loads this file at runtime any more -- it is documentation of the contract, kept alongside song_event_schema.json.

phase_vocabulary.description: Named internal phases of a composite gesture, anchored on a detected impact (constitution §1.2). A phase absent for a given gesture means no supporting primitive was found for it -- it is never guessed (constitution §2). A drop is never named directly: naming stays with the section-pair transition below (constitution §5.2) -- this vocabulary can only say 'a build of this shape happens here', never 'this is the drop'.

phases.name: approach
phases.description: An early riser or downlifter beginning to shape the run-up toward an impact, detected before the build phase starts.

phases.name: build
phases.description: A rising riser, or a doubling onset-density snare roll, immediately preceding the tension/impact.

phases.name: tension
phases.description: A pre-drop gap (near-silence immediately before impact) or a reverse-cymbal swell (rising mix-RMS into a transient spike) held in the bar before impact.

phases.name: impact
phases.description: A simultaneous sub-band and transient spike -- the crash-and-sub hit a gesture is anchored on.

phases.name: release
phases.description: The mix RMS staying elevated above its own pre-impact level for the two bars after an impact.

transition_vocabulary.description: One event per boundary in artifacts/section_segmentation/sections.json. That stage already merges consecutive equal-labelled phrase runs, so every remaining boundary is already a change in `function`; this vocabulary only names it, it never re-detects the boundary instant or claims a boundary is a drop.

removed_in_v3_0_item_9.description: The full Epic-5 event vocabulary (drop, drop_explode, drop_groove, drop_punch, soft_release, no_drop_plateau, fake_drop, tension_hold, pause_break, anthem_call, call_response, hook_phrase, vocal_spotlight, vocal_tail, energy_reset, layer_add, layer_remove, impact_hit, stinger, groove_loop, atmospheric_plateau, percussion_break, instrumental_bed, heartbeat_pattern, four_on_the_floor) and its category/alias/threshold-profile machinery were deleted together with the event_rules/event_machine/event_features stack that produced them (measured at chance against the gold set).
